==Hero Usage==
* Heroes will use this skill whenever it is charged.

==Notes==
* This skill exactly requires 120 units of adrenaline to be fully charged, so 4 strikes and 20 units.
* Synergizes with [[Auspicious Blow]], [[Fierce Blow]], and [[Heavy Blow]], for an Unblockable attack, Deep Wound, and Knockdown, respectively.

== Trivia ==
* The warrior in the [[skill icon]] appears to be wearing [[Warrior Elite Canthan armor|Elite Canthan armor]].
* The [[functionality]] of this skill has changed since its introduction; see its [[Forceful Blow/Skill history|skill history]] for details.
